test_template.subject: A question about research collaboration in carbon fiber composites
test_template.body:
Dear Dr. Czo,

I am writing to ask whether you would consider research collaboration with companies in China on carbon fiber composites.

I work with Qingfei Tech Talent Team, an agency in China. We help overseas researchers find industry partners and apply to a national talent programme initiated by the Chinese government.

We have not identified a company for you yet. We would first discuss your research interests, then look for companies with related R&D needs. Any application would require mutual interest and competitive review.

If selected, you could undertake part-time advisory work alongside your current position, combining remote work with short visits to China. The work, terms and visit schedule would be agreed with the company.

If this is relevant to your work, a brief note about the research topics you would consider discussing would help. We can continue by email.

Best regards,
LuKai
Qingfei Tech Talent Team

If you would prefer not to receive further emails from us, you can unsubscribe here: ${unsubscribeUrl}
